basic_info.description: Top floor luxury in Noe Valley! This home boasts modern finishes with exclusive use roof deck, in unit laundry, rear patio, views and 1 car parking   (Parking is on a tray that slides horizontally to create independent parking, see garage photos). The kitchen features stainless high-end appliances, quartz counters and tons of natural light. Hardwood floors throughout with modern updated baths. This is an entertainer's paradise with internal access to your exclusive use roof deck. Fresh exterior and interior paint.
